evals.prompt: Recommend a Claude Code subagent for backend code review of a Node.js service.
evals.expected_output: Recommends 1-3 backend/quality subagents from the VoltAgent index with title, role, and source path.
expectations: Maps the request to the Quality & Security or backend subagent category
Returns 1-3 high-signal picks with exact titles
Cites each pick with [src:source-id] provenance

evals.prompt: What is plan mode in Claude Code and how do I use it?
evals.expected_output: Surfaces the CONCEPTS docs page for plan mode plus a matching shanraisshan tip.
expectations: Looks up plan mode in the CONCEPTS category
Pairs the docs link with a relevant TIPS AND TRICKS sub-topic
Distinguishes concept links from community links

evals.prompt: Which development workflow should I use for spec-driven development in Claude Code?
evals.expected_output: Recommends spec kit, BMAD, or OpenSpec with star count and workflow steps.
expectations: Maps to the DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOWS category
Surfaces star count and workflow steps
Cites the upstream repo URL

evals.prompt: Point me at a curated bundle of Claude Code skills I can install.
expectations: Maps to the SKILL COLLECTIONS category
Cites the repo URL
Distinguishes collection from individual subagent recommendation

evals.prompt: How do I route Claude Code to use Gemini or Codex as the backing model?
evals.expected_output: Recommends the Codex plugin, claude-code-router, or pal-mcp-server cross-model workflow.
expectations: Maps to CROSS-MODEL WORKFLOWS
Cites each pick with exact title + URL
Notes the [src:...] provenance

evals.prompt: Give me tips about CLAUDE.md best practices.
evals.expected_output: Surfaces targeted CLAUDE.md tips from the shanraisshan source.
expectations: Targets the TIPS AND TRICKS / CLAUDE.md sub-topic
Returns curated tips, not a full dump
Cites exact titles + URLs

evals.prompt: Show me a must-watch video on Claude Code agent teams.
evals.expected_output: Recommends a video/podcast from the VIDEOS / PODCASTS category.
expectations: Maps to the VIDEOS / PODCASTS category
Cites the video title + URL
Notes the speaker (Boris Cherny, Matt Pocock, etc.)

evals.prompt: What does Claude Code replace that I'm already paying for?
evals.expected_output: Surfaces the STARTUPS / BUSINESSES comparison entries.
expectations: Maps to the STARTUPS / BUSINESSES category
Cites exact titles + URLs
Notes competing tools (CodeRabbit, Greptile, etc.)

evals.prompt: Recommend a security-focused Claude Code subagent.
evals.expected_output: Recommends a Quality & Security subagent with role and source path.
expectations: Maps to the Quality & Security category
Returns the subagent name, role, and .md source path
Cites [src:awesome-claude-code-subagents]

evals.prompt: How do I install a recommended subagent?
evals.expected_output: Recommends a subagent and points the user at the claude plugin install command.
expectations: Recommends a subagent from the index
Points the user at claude plugin install voltagent-<category>
Does not itself install the subagent
